enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping (with fan on due to heatwave)
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Turn over. Adjust fan. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Open eyes. Close eyes. Turn over. Adjust fan. Sleep. Turn over. Sleep. Open eyes at 06:30.

Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body. Turn off water heater. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and pan. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate. Toast bread. Spread butter. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Turn off kitchen light. Leave kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close closet. Remove towel. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out belt. Close drawer. Put on belt. Pick up bag. Check phone. Put phone in bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk off bus. Walk to office. Enter office building. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office on community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss program plans. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Write reports. Print documents. File papers. Talk to colleague. Use computer. Check phone. Drink water. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue working.

Stand up. Walk to lunch area. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Close refrigerator. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Take out apple. Eat sandwich. Eat apple. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw away trash. Walk back to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office on community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss program plans. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Write reports. Print documents. File papers. Talk to colleague. Use computer. Check phone. Drink water. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue working.

Stand up. Pack bag. Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot and pan. Close cupboard. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pot. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add water. Cover pot. Simmer. Turn off stove. Pour food into bowl. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes. Turn off kitchen light. Leave kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV (using fan, avoiding AC during peak tax)
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on fan. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust fan speed. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Continue watching TV. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off fan.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer for personal tasks and leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on couch. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Check social media. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open document. Write document. Save document. Close document. Open game. Play game. Pause game. Check phone. Reply to message. Resume game. Close game. Open video. Watch video. Close video. Turn off computer. Close laptop.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out pajamas. Close closet. Remove clothes. Put on pajamas. Pick up phone. Set alarm. Put down phone. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Turn over. Adjust fan. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn over. Sleep. Open eyes. Close eyes. Turn over. Sleep.
